### eBay UK Fees for Clothing (as of 2024)

| Fee Type | Typical Amount | Notes |
|----------|----------------|-------|
| **Insertion/Listing Fee** | **£0.30‑£1.30** per item (first 50 free, then per‑page charge) | 50 items per week are free. After that you pay a per‑page fee (£1.30 per page, 12 items = 1 page). |
| **Final Value Fee** | **6 %** of the sale price (including shipping) for most categories | Discounted down to 2.6 % for high‑volume sellers (3 % for sellers with >10 % of sales in 12 months). A minimum fee of £0.35 applies. |
| **Payment Processing Fee** | **£0.45 plus 2.4 %** of the sale price | Only if you use PayPal / eBay Payments. |
| **PayPal/VISA/Credit‑Card Fee** | **£0.45 plus 2.4 %** | Standard PayPal fee; if you use eBay Payments it’s the same. Virtual card & Apple Pay are included in this. |
| **Marketplace Fee (UK only)** | **0.5 %** (optional) | If you opt in to eBay’s “Marketing & Visibility” service. |

#### Quick rule‑of‑thumb for a typical £30 T‑shirt sale:

| Step | Amount | Cumulative |
|------|--------|------------|
| Insertion (free) | £0 | £0 |
| Final Value (6 % of £30) | £1.80 | £1.80 |
| PayPal (0.45 + 2.4 % of £30) | £0.45 + £0.72 = £1.17 | £2.97 |
| **Total Fees** | **≈ £2.97** | **≈ £9.9 % of sale price** |

> **Tip:** When you sell larger volumes, aim for the low‑rate final‑value fee (2.6 % or 3 %) and keep your listings optimized (free first 50, use the “Buy It Now” option, etc.) to minimise overall costs.
